messages:
Alex: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — consolidating action items and owners. I'll list items and tentative owners. Please confirm or reassign and paste JIRA IDs. Goal: owners + JIRA by EOD Friday.

Maria: sounds good. posting items now.

Alex: 1) KV cache eviction under high-regen load — root cause looks like an LRU race when prefixes collide under burst. Proposed owner: @Tyler. Needs repro, perf test, and a canary rollout. Tentative ETA 2w.

Tyler: I'll take this. Creating ticket now.

Tyler: Created https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2145 — summary: KV eviction LRU race + reproducer. ETA 2025-03-21. I'll add a minimal load script and perf baseline.

Maria: I'll review acceptance criteria and add validation steps. Please add me as watcher.

Alex: RACI for INF-2145 — R=Tyler, A=Eng-SRE, C=Maria, I=Product/Oncall. Add that to ticket.

Sophie: 2) Alert thresholds too noisy during partial degradations — owner: @Sophie. Need to tune thresholds and add contextual metadata so ops can triage faster.

Sophie: Created https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2146. ETA 2025-03-15 for threshold tuning + alert runbook updates. RACI: R=Sophie, A=Pranav (Product), C=Oncall, I=Eng teams.

Jamal: 3) Post-deploy smoke tests missing for runtime changes — owner: @Jamal. Add CI job + ops runbook; integrate with canary gate.

Jamal: Created https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2147. Linking runbook PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runbooks/pull/88

Alex: Handoff notes: Tyler implements patch and assigns Maria for validation once it lands in canary. Maria will own the controlled rollout and rollback criteria. Add explicit rollback thresholds in INF-2145.

Maria: noted. I'll add rollout playbook, rollback thresholds, and acceptance tests to INF-2145 today.

Tyler: tagging @postmortem-bot to add these action owners to the PM tracker.

postmortem-bot: Added INF-2145, INF-2146, INF-2147 to the action tracker and set provisional owners.

Alex: Weekly check-in scheduled Wednesdays 10:00am — owners please update ticket status before that sync. Also, recurring pattern: cache-related incidents roughly every ~6 weeks — let's track as a trend on the RCA board so we can prioritize systemic fixes.

Sophie: I'll prototype a small dashboard for cache error trends and alert spike correlation. Plan to share a mock by next Wednesday.

Tyler: Quick mitigation idea: decouple large payloads from the cache path to reduce eviction pressure. I'll prototype a branch with a size-based bypass.

Maria: Good mitigation. Please include perf numbers in the ticket and tag the canary experiments.

Alex: Action summary: owners assigned and JIRA tickets created (INF-2145, INF-2146, INF-2147). Each owner: confirm acceptance by EOD or reassign with ETA. We'll track RACI in each ticket and update the PM tracker.

Jamal: Confirmed on INF-2147, will push runbook PR updates tomorrow.

Pranav: I'll backstop product acceptance for INF-2146 and schedule a quick review with Sophie.

Alex: Thanks all :thumbsup: — if anyone can't meet the ETA, call it out here so we can redistribute before Friday.
